English: Every line clear grants +1 Blockcoin, but all future Milestone targets rise by 20%.
Chinese (Simplified): 每消除一行获得 +1 Blockcoin，但之后所有目标分数提高 20%。

English: Each card you own adds +0.02 to your global score multiplier.
Chinese (Simplified): 每拥有一张卡牌，全局分数倍率 +0.02。

English: Each tile placed in the center 2x2 area grants +4 points.
Chinese (Simplified): 放在中央 2x2 区域的每个方块 +4 分。

English: Each consecutive clear permanently adds +0.02 to your combo gain.
Chinese (Simplified): 每次连续消行都会永久提升连击增益 0.02。

English: Once per run, your combo survives when the charge bar empties.
Chinese (Simplified): 每局一次，能量条清空时连击不会中断。

English: Each tile placed on one of the four corners grants +3 points.
Chinese (Simplified): 放在四个角落的每个方块 +3 分。

English: Every 7 shapes, a rift opens with a 5-placement countdown. Clear it for +2 pool shapes; let it hit 0 and the tile is blocked for the rest of the Milestone.
Chinese (Simplified): 每放置 7 个方块出现一道裂隙，倒数 5 步。消除它可获得 +2 方块；归零则该格封锁至本目标结束。

English: This Milestone only spawns size 2-3 shapes, but their scores drop by 20%.
Chinese (Simplified): 本目标只出现 2-3 格的方块，但它们的分数降低 20%。

English: Clearing 2 or more lines at once multiplies the score by 1.5.
Chinese (Simplified): 一次消除 2 行或以上，分数 ×1.5。

English: The first 5 shapes this Milestone are free, but cannot be rotated.
Chinese (Simplified): 本目标的前 5 个方块免费，但不能旋转。

English: Raises this Milestone's target by 20%. Clear it and the next target drops 15%.
Chinese (Simplified): 当前目标提高 20%。若达成，下个目标降低 15%。

English: Each placement has a 20% chance to double its score - or halve it.
Chinese (Simplified): 每次放置有 20% 概率使分数翻倍——或减半。

English: A shape placed touching nothing is free. Works 3 times per Milestone.
Chinese (Simplified): 不接触任何方块的放置免费。每目标 3 次。

English: Pool capacity +6 shapes, but global score multiplier -0.10.
Chinese (Simplified): 方块储备 +6，但全局分数倍率 -0.10。

English: Finish a Milestone with 15 or more shapes left to start the next one with +3 pool capacity.
Chinese (Simplified): 以剩余 15 个及以上方块完成目标，下个目标储备 +3 开局。

English: Combo multiplier grows twice as fast, but every combo reset costs 2 shapes.
Chinese (Simplified): 连击倍率增长翻倍，但每次连击中断损失 2 个方块。

English: Horizontal clears score 2.5x. Vertical clears score nothing but still hold the combo.
Chinese (Simplified): 只有横行计分（2.5 倍）。竖列不计分但保持连击。

English: Every line you clear adds +0.05 to your combo multiplier gain.
At 3x combo or higher, an unplaceable shape vanishes instead of ending the run. Your combo drops to minimum.
Chinese (Simplified): 连击达 3x 以上时，无法放置的方块会消失而非结束游戏。连击降至最低值。

English: Two linked tiles appear on the board. Clearing one detonates the other and its neighbours for score. They move with every new draw.
Chinese (Simplified): 出现两个相连的格子。消除其一会引爆另一个及其周围并得分。每次抽取新方块时位置改变。

English: After 3 placements without a clear, your next clear scores double.
Chinese (Simplified): 连续 3 次放置未消行后，下次消行得分翻倍。

English: Emptying the entire board grants +100 Blockcoins and +2 combo.
Chinese (Simplified): 清空整个棋盘获得 +100 Blockcoin 和 +2 连击。

English: A blocked tile counts as filled for line clears but scores nothing. It relocates each time its line is cleared.
Chinese (Simplified): 封锁格在消行判定中算作已填充，但不计分。每次消除后会移动位置。

English: Cover the marked tile to keep your combo from falling below 2x. Clearing that tile costs you 8 shapes.
Chinese (Simplified): 覆盖标记格可防止连击跌破 2x。消除该格将损失 8 个方块。

English: All score you earn is increased by 10%.
Single-line clears score 2x and remove 2 random blocks. Clearing 2 or more lines scores nothing.
Chinese (Simplified): 单行消除得双倍分并随机移除 2 个方块。同时消除 2 行及以上不得分。

English: The first 5 shapes score half, but the last 10 shapes in the pool score triple.
Chinese (Simplified): 前 5 个方块得分减半，储备中最后 10 个方块得分三倍。

English: On a combo reset, the multiplier halves instead of dropping to minimum.
Chinese (Simplified): 连击中断时倍率减半，而非跌至最低值。

English: Vertical clears score 2.5x. Horizontal clears score nothing but still hold the combo.
Chinese (Simplified): 只有竖列计分（2.5 倍）。横行不计分但保持连击。

English: Maximum pool capacity is increased by 6 shapes.
Chinese (Simplified): 方块储备上限增加 6 个。

English: 4Gen tiles score +2, but 4Gen appears 5% less often.
Chinese (Simplified): 4Gen 方块 +2 分，但 4Gen 的出现率降低 5%。

English: 6Square tiles score +2, but 6Square appears 5% less often.
Chinese (Simplified): 6格方块 方块 +2 分，但 6格方块 的出现率降低 5%。

English: C tiles score +4, but C appears 8% less often.
Chinese (Simplified): C 方块 +4 分，但 C 的出现率降低 8%。

English: Cross tiles score +2, but Cross appears 3% less often.
Chinese (Simplified): 十字 方块 +2 分，但 十字 的出现率降低 3%。

English: Dot tiles score +8, but Dot appears 3% less often.
Chinese (Simplified): 点 方块 +8 分，但 点 的出现率降低 3%。

English: I3 tiles score +2, but I3 appears 5% less often.
Chinese (Simplified): I3 方块 +2 分，但 I3 的出现率降低 5%。

English: I4 tiles score +2, but I4 appears 7% less often.
Chinese (Simplified): I4 方块 +2 分，但 I4 的出现率降低 7%。

English: J tiles score +5, but J appears 7% less often.
Chinese (Simplified): J 方块 +5 分，但 J 的出现率降低 7%。

English: L tiles score +5, but L appears 10% less often.
Chinese (Simplified): L 方块 +5 分，但 L 的出现率降低 10%。

English: Long L tiles score +3, but Long L appears 12% less often.
Chinese (Simplified): 长L 方块 +3 分，但 长L 的出现率降低 12%。

English: O tiles score +2, but O appears 5% less often.
Chinese (Simplified): O 方块 +2 分，但 O 的出现率降低 5%。

English: S tiles score +2, but S appears 5% less often.
Chinese (Simplified): S 方块 +2 分，但 S 的出现率降低 5%。

English: T tiles score +3, but T appears 5% less often.
Chinese (Simplified): T 方块 +3 分，但 T 的出现率降低 5%。

English: Z tiles score +3, but Z appears 8% less often.
Chinese (Simplified): Z 方块 +3 分，但 Z 的出现率降低 8%。

Chinese (Simplified): 没有任何方块能放进棋盘了。

Chinese (Simplified): 在达成目标前方块已用完。

English: First Picks blocked rotation and nothing fits as drawn.
Chinese (Simplified): First Picks 禁用了旋转，方块无法放入。

English: You have reached the end of the demo. If you enjoyed it, adding the game to your wishlist helps a lot. Share your thoughts and suggestions with the feedback button.
Chinese (Simplified): 试玩到此结束。如果您喜欢，把游戏加入愿望单会是很大的支持。欢迎通过反馈按钮分享您的意见和建议。

English: Each level adds 2 shapes to your pool.
Chinese (Simplified): 每级使储备增加 2 个方块。

English: Each level grants one pool reroll per run.
Chinese (Simplified): 每级每局可重抽一次储备。

English: Each level grants one card reroll per run.
Chinese (Simplified): 每级每局可重抽一次卡牌。

English: Each level adds 0.03 to the combo gained per line clear.
Chinese (Simplified): 每级使每次消行获得的连击提升 0.03。

English: Each level refills the pool once instead of ending the run.
Chinese (Simplified): 每级可在无路可走时补充一次储备而不结束本局。

English: Each level adds one charge slot so your combo holds longer.
Chinese (Simplified): 每级增加一格连击槽 连击维持更久。

English: Each level earns 4% more coins from every Milestone.
Chinese (Simplified): 每级使每个目标的金币收益提高 4%。

English: Each level starts your run with 0.1 more combo multiplier.
Chinese (Simplified): 每级使开局连击倍率提高 0.1。

English: Shows where the shape will land.
Lifts the shape above your finger.
Disables screen shake and heavy animation.
Chinese (Simplified): 关闭画面震动和强烈动画。

English: This deletes your Blockcoins, upgrades and unlocks. This cannot be undone.
Chinese (Simplified): 这将删除你的 Blockcoin、升级和已解锁内容，且无法撤销。

English: Your current run will be lost.
Pick an upgrade above to see its details.
Chinese (Simplified): 在上方选择一项升级即可查看详情。
